--benchmark-type.help: Type of benchmark to run (default: fast-benchmark). Cannot be combined with --markers.

--e2e-only.help: Only measure end-to-end time (startup + LLM call)

--filter.help: Filter tests by name pattern (pytest -k equivalent)

--iterations.help: Number of iterations per test, max: 10 (default: %(default)s)

--markers.help: Custom pytest markers for test selection (combined with 'llm'). Cannot be combined with --benchmark-type.

--model.help: Model to use for e2e benchmark

--models.help: Comma-separated list of models to test (required)

--no-braintrust.help: Run without Braintrust integration (not recommended for benchmarks)

--no-strict-setup.help: Disable strict setup mode (allow setup failures) (default: strict setup enabled)

--only-setup.help: Run before_test only, skip test execution and port forwards

--parallel.help: Number of parallel workers or 'auto' for automatic detection (pytest -n equivalent) (default: %(default)s)

--prompt.default: hello, please reply with the word hello
--prompt.help: Prompt to use for e2e benchmarking

--skip-cleanup.help: Keep resources after test (useful for debugging setup)

--skip-setup.help: Skip before_test commands (useful for iterative testing)

--startup-only.help: Only measure startup time (deterministic, no LLM call)

--strict-setup-mode.help: Fail pytest if ANY setup fails

--use-post.help: Use POST method instead of GET
